description: This file defines the RemotePlugin class in the Rust namespace, which implements the Rust::IPlugin interface for a plugin system. It includes method declarations for plugin lifecycle management, activation, deactivation, message invocation, inbound message handling, and internal methods for launching remote processes and sending data. The class interacts with various plugin host interfaces and manages communication via a socket server.
